exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: exact Silent Storm fulltexture particle diffuse frame5735.
Input: the complete ORIGINAL storedRGB painting exposed as opaqueRGB using ONLY wholecanvas source NEAREST8x. This source-only guide is the precise edit target, not a style inspiration. Its geometry, broad shading, gaps and material are authoritative. Preserve the entire square canvas edge-to-edge; source native alpha is restored independently in the game.
Primary request: faithfully resolve coarse source pixels into restrained finer painted detail, keeping the EXACT normalized sourceUV, full occupied footprint, original contour/holes/gaps, number and location of every source component, component sizes, and original broad material shading/pattern scale. Keep source black background and empty areas unchanged. Do not move, reinterpret, relight, strengthen weak components or add artistic information.
Source invariants: Exact compact central muted red/brown painted ember/char fragment group, confined to the source footprint with original irregular gaps and holes. Preserve ALL existing fragment components, silhouettes, numbers and sizes by following the reference exactly. Do not add individual chunks, rocks, fissures, new bright embers, sparks or peripheral fragments. Resolve existing pixels into quiet painted material only, never glossy or volumetric stone.
Material: original soft matte diffuse painting with precisely the source color/palette and low-contrast broad tonal patches. Retain the source smooth blurred powder/smoke/fire/ember character and soft boundaries; fine HD paint must remain subordinate to those original broad patches. Source brightness will be corrected numerically later; keep all relative dark/core/peripheral intensities as in the reference. Do not make the central core brighter relative to the faint outer region. No oversharpened edges or increased local contrast.
Constraints: no crop, zoom, shift, rotate, recenter, padding, added whitespace/frame, bbox fit, atlas/grid, repacking, composite or scene. No invented component, additional fleck/spark/glint, rock/debris fragment, luminous curl, cauliflower fold/turbulence, rays, new cracks, shiny rim or dramatic extra smoke. No text, numeral, glyph, logo, symbol, object or decorative pattern. Weak source details stay weak; black gaps stay black. Output opaque fullcanvasRGB with original square aspect; generated alpha must NOT replace original nativeA. Only faithfully refine the existing source painting.

source_transform_recipe.operations: native stored RGBA to opaqueRGB only; wholecanvas NEAREST8x, preserve original aspect; no crop/padding/rotation/UV fitting/BBox/composite/unpremultiplication/art insertion. Original sourceA restored separately by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to exact original4x, sourceA LANCZOS4x separately; private scalar brightness/native premultiply matches Type.

prompt_serialization: Exact built-in prompt argument preserves CRLF and equals UTF-8 prompt file bytes without trailing newline.
reference_argument_serialization: Actual reference tool arguments used absolute repository paths. Portable metadata names exact reference PNG identities with unchanged byte SHA256.
